name: Kazama Natsuki
source: Natsuki is that energetic, friendly type of girl who is pretty much friends with everyone. She is associated with the swimming team and enjoys anything athletic. The story really starts out with her losing her gym uniform, which she originally suspects the protagonist but later find out it was someone else, and with Kazuma saving her from perverts on the train, she genuinely start falling for the protagonist.
